Good, all imports are used. The test class is complete and self-contained.

## Summary

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/DiffBuilderAgentTest.java` with 66 test methods covering `DiffBuilder`:

- The new `Builder<T>` fluent API: missing left/right throws on `build()`, getters, default/explicit `ToStringStyle`, default/custom `toStringFormat`, and `testObjectsEquals` true/false behavior (including the trivial-equality short-circuit).
- Deprecated 3-arg and 4-arg constructors: null-left/right NPEs, null-style default fallback, `testObjectsEquals=false` behavior.
- Every `append` overload (`boolean`, `byte`, `char`, `double` incl. NaN, `float`, `int` incl. `Integer.MIN/MAX_VALUE`, `long`, `short`, and their array forms, plus `Object`/`Object[]`) for both equal and differing inputs, asserting on diff count, field name, and boxed left/right values.
- `append(String, Object, Object)` dispatch logic: same-reference short-circuit, null handling, matching primitive-array delegation, mismatched primitive-array types compared as plain objects, and mismatched `Object[]` subtypes.
- `append(String, DiffResult)`: null-diffResult NPE (including when the outer objects are already equal, proving the null check isn't bypassed), nested field-name prefixing, empty nested diffs, and skip-on-equal-objects.
- Fluent chaining (`append` returns `this`) and `build()` reflecting builder state at call time.
- A null field name triggering `NullPointerException` only when a diff is actually created (via `Diff`'s constructor), not when short-circuited.

Ran via `./_tools/test.sh org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.DiffBuilderAgentTest`: **66/66 passed**, no files other than this test class were modified.
